title: Junior Development Engineer
content_text:
About the role 
As a Junior Development Engineer, under guidance you'll gain practical experience reviewing development applications, assessing engineering designs, and supporting the delivery of quality infrastructure outcomes. Working within a collaborative and experienced team, you'll develop your knowledge of development engineering, planning legislation, and sustainable development practices. This is an exciting opportunity to build a rewarding engineering career while helping to Rewrite the Future of the Central Coast. 
Applicant Profile 
To be successful in this role, you will have: 
- Currently completing Civil Engineering degree (3rd/4th yr) OR demonstrated solid contemporary experience in Development Engineering. 
- Hold a current Class C or Provisional P1 or Ps Driver's Licence 
- Knowledge related to civil engineering design and land use development and a general knowledge of development and environmental planning 
- An understanding and/or interpretation codes, policies and precures related to civil engineering for land use development 
- Exposure to the Environmental Planning and Assessment Act, the Roads Act and the Local Government Act is required together with an awareness of other related environmental and planning legislations/regulations 
Offer Details 
The commencing salary for this position is up to $80,030.20. Central Coast Council also provides progression opportunities for employees to progress up to the maximum salary of $92,727.03 on completion of assessment of skills and performance plus 12% superannuation 
- We have a temporary full-time role available 
- This role will be able to access a 9 day fortnight 
- We are able to offer hybrid and flexible working conditions for this role - 2 days from home and 3 days onsite 
- This role is located at the Wyong Administration Building 
Want to know more? 
The contact person for this role is John Noakes, Section Manager, Development Engineering. You can contact John on 0417 486 569. 
This position will close for applications at midnight on Sunday, 18 October 2026. 
We will not accept unsolicited resumes or applications being presented by recruitment agencies.
